Delivery recorded for **candidate_01** (viewer: `candidate_01/viewer.html`). Final report:

## Delivered model
**candidate_01** — single floor F1, 8 spaces, 8 declared partitions, 21 openings (10 doors, 11 windows), 10 door connections. Source-geometry validation: pass (0 unbuilt/unsupported openings). Built with `build_plan_bim` from observed pixel wall paths, so rooms and opening hosts were derived deterministically — no hand-enumerated vertices.

## Coordinate frame and calibration (evidence retained)
- From the original dimension chains, which sum exactly: top 540+1600+2520+4800+540 = **10000 mm**; left 540+1500+2380+1200+1740+1500+1220+1500+3080+4800+540 = **20000 mm**. These were anchored to the measured outer wall faces (grey double-line bands): x px 249→0 m, 610→10 m; y px 877→0 m (south), 152→20 m (north). Scale 27.70 mm/px (x), 27.59 mm/px (y). Chain segment boundaries matched measured wall/opening ink transitions to within ~2–3 px on every facade.
- **Dimension baselines vs wall faces:** footprint uses observed **outer faces**; exterior thickness 240 mm is annotated in the plan. Interior partitions are drawn as unannotated thin double lines (~150–200 mm); they are modelled as **measured centrelines** (V1 centre x≈400 consistent with the 4180 chain; V2 centre x≈460 with the 1640 chain). Partition endpoints were regularized to the footprint boundary where ink stops at inner faces — recorded in the saved basis.
- The tool flagged a cross-axis scale disagreement (36.10 vs 36.25 px/m, 0.41 %). This reflects ±1 px in reading the outer-face lines over 361/725 px; per-axis scales were used, and the disagreement is preserved in the delivery record rather than silently blended.

## Physical layout recovered
North open office (full width); west column: office_a, office_b, south conference room; east column: room_c, room_d meeting room; **L-shaped corridor+lobby circulation kept intact** (the corridor's east wall demonstrably ends at y≈582 px — no ink between there and the y≈699 wall — so corridor and entry lobby are one connected space); L-shaped south-east work room with its own external door. Doors: corridor-mouth double door (1.19 m) plus 6 single doors off the corridor/lobby, 3 exterior doors. All 8 spaces are connected; no space is isolated.

## Verification performed
- Facade openings measured by cyan profiles on all four walls; every chain segment matched an observed wall pier or aperture.
- `view_plan_wall_support(draft_003, grey, tol 60, r=5)`: every declared path is fully ink-supported. All unsupported samples (G01–G20) are 2–4 px T-junction artifacts at wall crossings or 1-px offsets at exterior face lines — **no missing wall spans, no undeclared apertures**; nothing was deleted or invented to clear the report.
- Clean-original vs marked-panel comparison, both adjoining spaces of each divider checked; compiled source plan and original-image overlay inspected visually and agree with the drawing's partition topology.

## Limitations (unverified scope — stated honestly)
- **All heights are assumptions**: no elevation/section was supplied. z=0, ceiling 3.0 m, doors 0–2.1 m, windows 0.9–2.7 m are declared assumptions; `check_openings(heights_only)` confirms all 21 openings are height-unchecked with no image-linked evidence.
- Interior partition thickness approximated as zero (drawing gives no value).
- Swing orientations and door operating states not encoded; the corridor-mouth mark was read as one double door (two ~0.6 m leaves).
- Furniture, swing arcs, and text were treated as non-structure after checking full wall paths; drawing fidelity remains **not evaluated** — internal consistency and agreement with my own calibration do not certify reconstruction of the real building.
